MemoService is served over two protocols:

1. **gRPC-Gateway (REST/HTTP)** — `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` (line 108: `v1pb.RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer(ctx, gwMux, s)`), with the generated gateway code in `proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service.pb.gw.go`
2. **Connect (Connect RPC)** — `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go` (line 40: `apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler(s, opts...)`), with the generated Connect service definitions in `proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/memo_service.connect.go`
